Author: Kotanna
Name: Commendable
Punchline: Remembers who helped you in a duty, for the player commendation.
Description: Records what other players chose to do for you during a duty: raises, Dance Partner, Kardia, Synastry and Fey Union, protection, cards, Esuna and more. When the duty ends it shows a per-player summary beside the game's commendation window, with an event log for each player. Bookmark players with a note from their right-click menu. A memory aid only: no scores, and it never commends for you. /commendable
